meta.name: meta-ads-creative
meta.description: Create evidence-based Meta ad creative briefs, copy angles, and testable asset concepts for Facebook and Instagram. Use when asked for Meta ad creative, Facebook ads copy, Instagram ad assets, UGC concepts, creative briefs, new ad concepts, or creative refreshes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出 Meta 广告创意简报与可测试素材概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责 Meta 广告，需要快速生成有依据的创意简报和测试方案。
copy.tagline_en: Generate evidence-based Meta ad creative briefs and testable asset concepts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Meta ads and need fresh, evidence-based creative angles.

howto.what: 帮你基于真实客户语言和账户数据,产出 Facebook 和 Instagram 广告的创意简报、文案角度和可测试素材概念;每个概念会标注证据、假设、CTA、声明来源与衡量计划,不编造证言或数据。
howto.when: 当你要求写 Meta/Facebook/Instagram 广告创意、广告文案、UGC 概念、创意简报、新广告概念或创意刷新时触发;若账户上下文缺失,会建议先做 /meta-ads-audit。

say.text: 给这个 campaign 做一份创意简报,基于现有账户数据。
say.note: 会产出带证据和假设的概念列表。

say.text: 为 Instagram 想三个可测试的 UGC 素材概念,每个带一个待测变量。
say.note: 会生成 hypothesis slate,不直接上传素材。

say.text: 广告疲劳了,帮我看看是否该刷新创意,并写刷新方案。
say.note: 会先核对频次和链接 CTR,再给刷新假设。

howto.what_en: Helps produce evidence-based Meta ad creative briefs, copy angles, and testable asset concepts for Facebook and Instagram. Each concept includes hypothesis, evidence, hook, visual brief, CTA, claim ledger, and measurement plan; it does not invent testimonials or data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Meta ad creative, Facebook/Instagram ad copy, UGC concepts, creative briefs, new ad concepts, or creative refreshes. If context or creative inventory is missing, it recommends /meta-ads-audit first.

say_en.text: Create a creative brief for this campaign based on current account data.
Give me three testable UGC concepts for Instagram, each with one variable to test.
say_en.note: Generates a hypothesis slate, not uploads.

say_en.text: My ads are fatiguing. Check if I should refresh the creative and write a plan.
say_en.note: Verifies frequency and link CTR before proposing a refresh.
